content_sections.heading: Bharathidasan University Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 1 for Project Associate II, 1 for Project Associate I, and 1 for Project Assistant.

content_sections.heading: Bharathidasan University Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Associate II: M.Sc. in Microbiology / Biotechnology / Life Sciences or equivalent AND Two years' experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions, or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services with publications. Project Associate I: M.Sc. in Microbiology / Biotechnology / Life Sciences or equivalent. Project Assistant: B. Tech./ M. Tech. Biotechnology or B.Sc./ M.Sc. in Botany/ Zoology/ Microbiology/ Biotechnology/ Any life sciences degree.

content_sections.heading: Bharathidasan University Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 35 years for all posts. Age relaxation rules will be as per government norms. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: Bharathidasan University Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Project Associate II: Rs. 35,000/ - + 18% HRA (Rs. 41,300/ - pm) Project Associate I: Rs. 31,000/ - + 18% HRA (Rs. 36,580/ - pm) for NET/ GATE qualified or Rs. 25,000/ - + 18% HRA (Rs. 29,500/ - pm) for others Project Assistant: Rs. 20,000/ - + 18% HRA (Rs. 23,600/ - pm)

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Bharathidasan University Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for Bharathidasan University recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Bharathidasan University recruitment is scheduled for 21 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the different posts available in this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: Bharathidasan University is recruiting for three posts: Project Associate-II, Project Associate-I, and Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: For the Project Assistant post, candidates need to have a B. Tech./M. Tech. Biotechnology or a B.Sc./M.Sc. in Botany/Zoology/Microbiology/Biotechnology/Any life sciences degree.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for these positions?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the candidates applying for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts is 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-II position?
faq.answer: The Project Associate-II position offers a salary of Rs. 35,000/- plus 18% HRA, amounting to Rs. 41,300/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are there in total?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Project Associate-II, Project Associate-I, and Project Assistant posts.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these contractual positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Bharathidasan University, Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu, 620024.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs.
